user.title: Set up Discord Assist
user.description: An existing Discord Conversation bot was found. Import its token and settings (the old entry is disabled, not deleted), or enter a bot token.

data.idle_minutes: Reset a conversation after this many idle minutes
data.allowlist: Allowed Discord user IDs (act as the fallback user; mapped users are always allowed)
data.speaker_context: Tell the agent who is speaking, from which channel, and the local time
data.event_exclude_text: Exclude message text from the discord_assist_message event (event data is stored by the recorder)
data.prefer_local: Try Home Assistant's built-in commands first, then the agent
data.agent_timeout: Give up on the agent after this many seconds
data.rate_limit_per_minute: Max requests per Discord user per minute (0 = no limit)
data.rate_limit_burst: Requests a Discord user may send in a burst before the limit applies
data.placeholder_delay: Show a working placeholder after this many seconds

token.title: Discord bot token
token.description: Paste the bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. Enable the Message Content privileged intent for the application before using channel listening.

error.invalid_auth: The bot token was rejected by Discord.

error.invalid_user_id: That is not a valid Discord user ID (digits only).
error.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different bot than this entry.

add_room.title: Room channel
add_room.description: Pick a device in the room this channel stands for (any device in that area works). Requests in the channel and its threads then default to that room, like a voice satellite.

abort.no_rooms: No channels are mapped to rooms.

no_authorized_users.title: Nobody can use {entry_title}
no_authorized_users.description: Discord Assist only answers Discord users it can run as a Home Assistant user. Open the integration options and add a Discord-to-Home-Assistant user mapping, or set allowed Discord user IDs plus a fallback Home Assistant user. Until then the bot ignores every message.

message_content_intent.title: {entry_title} needs the Message Content intent
message_content_intent.description: Discord refused the gateway connection because the bot does not have the Message Content privileged intent. Enable it under Bot > Privileged Gateway Intents in the Discord Developer Portal, then reload the integration.
